Class Floor

java.lang.Object
Floor
public class Floor extends Object
Represents one of the floors of a Dungeon.

Contains the map for the gameplay, tracking the Player, grid, and entities on it. It generates a map by reading from the Layouts and populating the grid. It processes Player actions and manages creature actions.

  • Method Details

    • tick

      public boolean tick(char choice)
      Processes one cycle of player input.

      If a direction is chosen, an interaction and movement are attempted on the corresponding Tile. If the Tile interacted with is the Exit, the exit would have been set to true by the tile, allowing the player to proceed to the next floor.

      The usage and switching of held Items is handled by the Controller.processDungeonInput. If the player fails to move during this cycle, they will idle and trigger any idle effects on their current Tile.

      After these, the turn of every Creature on the floor is processed.

      Parameters:
      choice - the input character representing the player's choice.
      Returns:
      true if the exit has been reached, false if not. This notifies the Dungeon if the floor is finished.

    • interact

      private void interact(int y, int x, int offY, int offX)
      Processes an interaction between the Player with a nearby Tile.

      Triggers any interactions on the target Tile. Also damages Creature on the target Tile. If after both of these, no blocking entities were detected, moves the Player onto the target Tile. Otherwise, triggers the idle effects on their current Tile.

      This also deletes the Structure from the grid and structures if the structure should be destroyed as a result of the interaction.

      This also drops the Loot of and deletes the Creature from the grid and creatures if the creature should die as a result of the interaction.

      Parameters:
      y - distance of the current position from the top edge.
      x - distance of the current position from the left edge.
      offY - how many spaces downwards the Tile that the Player is interacting with is.
      offX - how many spaces to the right the Tile that the Player is interacting with is.

    • step

      private void step(int y, int x)
      Picks up loot when moving the Player.

      Picks up all of the loot on the Tile that the Player moved to. After the Loot is obtained, this also deletes it from the grid and loots.

      Parameters:
      y - distance of the destination position from the top edge.
      x - distance of the destination position from the left edge.

    • generateYasudayaRyokan

      private void generateYasudayaRyokan()
      Generates a floor for the Yasudaya Ryokan dungeon. Randomly selects one of the Layouts under the dungeon and converts it into useable data.

    • convertLayout

      private void convertLayout(String[] layout)
      Converts the Layout by scanning each character and initializing their corresponding Tiles in the grid. The grid is initialized with sizes sizeY and sizeX, which are obtained from getting the number of strings and the length of the strings from the Layout.

      This also adds the reference to each generated Structure, Creature, and Loot to the structures, creatures, and loots lists as well.

      Once the Spawn is found, it stores the location as spawnY and spawnX.

      Parameters:
      layout - the layout data to convert into data.

      source - the source of the damage.

    • isInBounds

      public boolean isInBounds(int y, int x)
      Checks if the target Tile is in bounds. Tiles can not have a negative position, and can not have a position greater than or equal to the size of the corresponding grid axis.
      Parameters:
      y - distance of the target position from the top edge.
      x - distance of the target position from the left edge.
      Returns:
      true if the position is within bounds, false otherwise.
